Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I've been researching English academies in Bangladesh, and Manchester English Academy with online course offerings caught my attention. The biggest leak in education businesses is usually in lead conversion — students enquire about courses via phone or social media, but there's no automated way to qualify them before a counsellor spends time on a call.

Here's the pattern I see: a student messages your page asking about IELTS preparation or spoken English. Right now, someone manually replies, asks about their goals and current level, schedules a consultation, and follows up. That's a lot of manual coordination, and leads go cold when replies are delayed.

I built an AI education consultant agent that handles enquiries 24/7 — it asks about learning goals, current level, preferred schedule (online vs in-person), and budget, then recommends the right course, schedules a demo class, and sends automated reminders. It also follows up with students who enquired but didn't enrol.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
